entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it about a month ago, and it's just not working right.
I'm sorry to hear that, but I can definitely look into it for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical problem. The main issue is that it won't sync consistently with the app. And when it does, the readings are erratic. I'm pretty sure the unit is broken.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I see the term 'broken' here. Can you give me the order number?

Yes, it's VF886-012. Look, I know it's been a little over 30 days. If a full refund is off the table, would you consider a partial credit? It seems defective, and I just want a product that works as advertised.
I understand your concern. Let me just pull up your order and check our policy. One moment... Okay, I see the order was delivered 39 days ago.
Right, so I assume I'm outside the main window. Is a discount code for a replacement something you could do?

Actually, you're perfectly fine. I'm looking at our knowledge base, and our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. You're unfortunately outside that timeframe.
Oh, really? 10 days? I completely misread that. That's fantastic news.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're reporting the item is defective, we can process a full return for you right away. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file now. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you, David, I appreciate the help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, we'll issue the full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
